exposure: Temporary balloon occlusion of the internal iliac artery
outcome: Blood loss of more than 1000 mL
cohort: Women with anterior placenta previa who delivered by cesarean between January 1, 2001, and September 30, 2012 at Amphia Hospital Breda (Breda, Netherlands)
finding: Temporary balloon occlusion of the internal iliac artery before uterine incision during cesarean delivery could potentially reduce blood loss among patients with anterior placenta previa.
